title: Add REKTY GENERATOR to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [REKTY GENERATOR](https://visualaiartwork.pages.dev) to image
- REKTY GENERATOR is a free, open-source AI image generator web app that supports multiple providers in one interface. It uses **Pollinations AI** for: - **Image generation** via Pollinations API (57+ m

Fixes #13602

gist.headline: One garden, many brushes
gist.blurb: REKTY GENERATOR has landed in the app garden. It gathers a small forest of image providers into one open-source canvas, with Pollinations handling the pixels.
gist.summary: Added REKTY GENERATOR to the app directory, a free open-source AI image generator that uses the Pollinations API for image generation alongside 57+ models in a unified interface.
gist.impact: People exploring Pollinations-powered apps can now find REKTY GENERATOR and create images through its multi-provider interface.
gist.visual_concept: Depict REKTY GENERATOR as a cozy shared art studio: Polli helps a friendly creator paint several tiny framed AI landscapes from one retro workstation, while different provider brushes and palettes sit together on the desk. Code-plants, flowers, and an app-directory sign make it clear this is a new community app joining the garden.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art community art studio where the cute Pollinations bee mascot—with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, black antennae, black oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, happy smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings—wears a tiny painter’s beret and helps a retro computer create several small framed AI images from one canvas; code-plants and flowers grow around a prominently lime green (#ecf874) REKTY GENERATOR sign. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, dark purple (#110518) outlines, simple pixel-font text: “REKTY GENERATOR”, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
